mapper.select: SELECT id, train_no, start_station_id, end_station_id, depart_time, arrive_time, sale_start_time, sale_end_time, status FROM train WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, train_no, start_station_id, end_station_id, depart_time, arrive_time, sale_start_time, sale_end_time, status FROM train WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY train_no ASC
SELECT id, station_name, city FROM station ORDER BY station_name ASC

SELECT t.train_no, tsa.station_seq AS from_seq, tsb.station_seq AS to_seq, tsa.depart_time AS depart_time, tsb.arrive_time AS arrive_time FROM train t JOIN train_station tsa ON tsa.train_id = t.id JOIN station sa ON sa.id = tsa.station_id JOIN train_station tsb ON tsb.train_id = t.id JOIN station sb ON sb.id = tsb.station_id WHERE t.status = 1 AND sa.station_name = #{fromStation} AND sb.station_name = #{toStation} AND tsa.station_seq < tsb.station_seq ORDER BY tsa.depart_time ASC, t.train_no ASC

SELECT 1 FROM train t JOIN train_station tsa ON tsa.train_id = t.id JOIN station sa ON sa.id = tsa.station_id JOIN train_station tsb ON tsb.train_id = t.id JOIN station sb ON sb.id = tsb.station_id WHERE t.status = 1 AND sa.station_name = #{fromStation} AND sb.station_name = #{toStation} AND tsa.station_seq < tsb.station_seq LIMIT 1
SELECT t.train_no AS trainNo, ts.station_seq AS stationSeq, s.station_name AS stationName FROM train_station ts JOIN train t ON t.id = ts.train_id JOIN station s ON s.id = ts.station_id
